verdict.rationale: Whether founders can begin the online filing flow without an account, or via a file-number entry path, is a fair question for a national company registry, so the axis applies. The evidence pack contains only two probes: both mca.gov.in and nsws.gov.in returned HTTP 403 at robots.txt, and no pages were fetched. With no published page evidencing a keyless or file-number entry path, the verdict is none. Confidence is low because the wall blocked inspection rather than showing the capability is absent.
